_doc: melodic_swapper: swaps some notes of a melodic line for new ones in the scale; the rhythm stays. Copy this file to your setup folder (the ostinato_generators tool does it) and change any value; keys starting with _ are comments.
_notes_per_trigger: How many notes change per trigger, as probabilities by count (normalised; capped at the notes there are).
_intensity_gain: A longer knob turn (intensity 2, 3, ...) changes more notes: the count drawn from notes_per_trigger times 1 + gain x (intensity - 1). 0: the turn's length does not matter.
_scale_source: "own": the track's scale; "auto": its own, or borrowed from the first other track that has a scale; or a track number to borrow from (the device says which key each track has).
_fallback_scale: No scale anywhere: "pattern" (the pitch classes the pattern already uses) or "chromatic".
_keep_first_note: Never change the pattern's first note (keeps the line anchored).
_chords: Steps with several notes: "top" changes the highest note only, "skip" leaves them alone.
_avoid_repeat: The new note always differs from the old one.
_range: Semitones the new notes may go below the pattern's lowest / above its highest note.
_max_leap: Largest interval (semitones) from the previous note.
_motion: Weights for the interval from the previous note: step (1-2 semitones), skip (3-4), leap (5 and more).
_tone_weights: Extra weight for scale degrees of the new note.
_transition: When the note after a swapped one is a target (root, third, fifth of the scale), with this probability the swapped note becomes a chromatic approach to it: a semitone below or above (weights), even outside the scale.
_seed: null: different every time; a number: repeatable results.

_ui._doc: Hints for settings forms: choices ("#track": the device's track numbers) and slider ranges [min, max, step] by dotted key.
